title: The second numbering of the people
english: On [[the second numbering of the people >> Bible:Numbers 26]]: earlier reading cut us short; we now make it good. By the Lord’s command the people were first numbered.
translator_notes: Copy-text Baehrens GCS 30 / Origenes Werke VII (1921), Rufinus Latin.
True OET: no ANF; do not copy Scheck FOTC (Numbers).

title: The first census fell by sin
english: Those first enrolled [[fell through persistence in sin >> Bible:Numbers 14:29-35]]. The former count is voided by faults.
